sentences.text: I could not find any in-force evidence stating a minimum credit score for home loans in the materials reviewed for housing loans, loan-purpose wording, or interest-rate presentation.
The in-force housing-loan materials I found describe housing-loan purposes and floating-rate or interest-rate display requirements, not a credit-score threshold.
The withdrawn circulars in the record concern floating-rate reset instructions and loan disclosure instructions, and they do not provide a minimum credit score for home loans.
